goal: Translate the visual system into a restrained personal deck-management page with identity, inventory clarity and safe destructive actions.

requiredDirection.surface: warm-white paper inventory with a contained navy identity masthead
requiredDirection.composition: compact identity/counts -> clear create action -> rectangular management tabs -> deck/draft inventory -> confirmation modal
requiredDirection.geometry: low-radius 1px rules, rectangular cards and tabs, no full Hero or dominant pills
requiredDirection.colorRoles: navy identity and structure, red destructive/publish semantics, yellow sparse selection, preserve hidden/danger/empty semantics
requiredDirection.type: restrained CJK labels with strong short identity/count numerics

mustNotDo: make delete look like a primary positive action
change management behavior or other routes
acceptance: 390/536/1280 show identity, create action, tabs and first inventory content within a useful first screen
all four branches and empty/delete-confirm states remain legible and keyboard-operable
masked recognition comes from inventory composition and component family
zero overflow, external writes during QA or cross-route regression
